cover_headline: Sensex Surges 905 Points, Nifty Tops 22,900 as Banking and FMCG Stocks Lead
facts: The BSE Sensex jumped 905.01 points, or 1.24%, to close at 74,151.04 on Thursday
The NSE Nifty rose 237.90 points, or 1.05%, to 22,936.75
Adani Ports was the top Sensex gainer, rising over 5% after reporting an 18% increase in quarterly net profit to Rs 3,682.44 crore

end.headline: Sensex Surges 905 Points, Nifty Tops 22,900 as Banking and FMCG Stocks Lead
end.line: The rally snapped a two-day losing streak as a US Fed rate hold, easing crude and Adani Ports strong results lifted sentiment.

quote.text: Buying was visible across several pockets, with realty, FMCG and select banking stocks leading the recovery.
quote.speaker: Ajit Mishra
